scope: Evidence audit, no training or strategy-source modifications, 2026-10-21 Asia/Shanghai

current_source_snapshot.caveat: These source findings apply to files observed on 2026-10-21. Source code evolved after historical runs. Without an exact archived code hash, findings cannot automatically be attributed to each historical run. Saved-return metrics are separate observed evidence.

daily_rebalancing.signal_refresh: qlp/dataset.py:139-150 decision_index uses np.arange(..., rb), rb=21 in saved config.
daily_rebalancing.carry_targets: run_policy.py:466-475 hold_forward fills out[t:stop]=grid[t] on every intervening date.
daily_rebalancing.daily_execution: qlp/execution.py:141 loops over every date; :155 only tests valid NAV and t>0; :162 reads tg[t-1]; :189 blends toward target; :218-219 calculate each-day desired notional and delta.
daily_rebalancing.interpretation: Signals refresh every 21 sessions; between signals the executor attempts daily restoration toward the carried target. This is execution frequency, not a claim that neural-network training runs daily.

cap_mismatch.training: qlp/policy.py:60 cap_soft=False; :121-122 applies capped_simplex_soft only when true; run_policy.py:780-787 constructs config without enabling cap_soft.
cap_mismatch.readout: run_policy.py:453-456 projects the network stock output to a hard cap; executor additionally applies feasible constraints.

03_policy_original.name: Relationship-enhanced direct-weight MLP p1
03_policy_original.definition: Shared per-stock encoder; cash scalar logit; stock/cash softmax; hard executor caps stock weights. Signals refresh every 21 sessions but carried targets are rebalanced daily. cap_soft=False in training.
03_policy_original.objective_current_code: Average portfolio arithmetic return minus 25bp turnover surrogate plus 0.5*L2*sum(encoder weight squared)
03_policy_original.data: 2010-01-04 to 2026-09-28; 5221 securities; eligible top1000 lagged-liquidity universe
03_policy_original.claim_boundary: Descendant of F17 project, not a neural network using exactly the same 17 original factors.

04_policy_literature.name: Policy v2/v3 ablations and quasi-holdout
unrun: Dynamic previous-weight/account-state branches have no validated result in research log
04_policy_literature.claim_boundary: Exploratory literature-inspired modifications; selected 2021 results do not prove improvement or independent OOS.

04_nn_return_branch.name: Independent F17-feature return-regression NN v1/v4/v5
04_nn_return_branch.loss: Date-equal Huber(delta=1) on return labels scaled by training-date-equal lower weighted median absolute return.
04_nn_return_branch.first_selection: 2013-2018 training, 2019-2020 validation, 2021 outer prediction; later years freeze lr/wd and reselect epochs on trailing two validation years.
04_nn_return_branch.feature_processing: Formation universe; 3*MAD*1.4826 winsorization; industry/size residualization; cross-sectional z-score ddof1; within-date median fill; missingness flags.
04_nn_return_branch.v1_readout: 2021-01-04 to 2026-09-28 daily frictionless adjusted-price ledger, 50 names, retention rank80, 3% cap, NN softmax versus F17 equal; no future-label filter.
04_nn_return_branch.v4_v5_readout: 58 formation dates 2021-01-22 to 2025-12-31; realized labels through 2026-02-03; conditional on future label availability; top50 equal; periodic diagnostic only.

packaging.environment: Python3.12; numpy,pandas,scipy,torch,scikit-learn,pyarrow. CPU metric audit only requires numpy,pandas.
